title: Sammy Hagar's Love Walks In lyrics came from nowhere

tellings.quote: and now that's um Sammy told me that the the song Love Walks in he don't even know where the words came from.

plain: The rock singer Sammy Hagar does not know where the words to his 1986 song Love Walks In came from. That is according to Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had repeated encounters with UFOs, who tells Michels that Hagar told him this himself. If it is true, it would put a famous song among the stories of ideas that seem to arrive from outside the person who writes them down.
